The cake is topped with thick, dark brown chocolate sauce drizzled in ribbons down the side. There is also a pool of chocolate sauce on the plate to the left, next to a red berry (strawberry/raspberry) and a small piece of chocolate garnish. A decorative arch of hardened chocolate sits on top of the cake.
